And I do also want to address the issue of the evidentiary, or I'm sorry, of the violation as Mr. Kelly has alleged of section 3105.171, that somehow the adoption of the receiver's recommendation constituted a modification of the decree. And it did not, that did not consist of a modification for the reasons that we've discussed here today. The decree which incorporated that agreed entry is still a contract between the parties. And the court has to enforce and carry out the provisions of that contract between the party as it's written and well-established law that the best intent of the parties is reflected within that document as it is written. And the intent of the parties again was to distribute their assets, have Mr. Camp to ultimately make the decision if they were unable to get it resolved on how that was to occur.
